# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [ArtCraft expands its AI-built open-source software suite](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/artcraft-rebuilds-open-source-tools.html): ArtCraft is using coding agents to rebuild familiar creative tools in Rust, turning software cloning from a demo into an open-source product strategy.
- [Anthropic brings Claude into live meetings and shared work](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-meetings-builds-artifacts-live.html): Claude Meetings joins Google Meet calls as a visible participant, turning spoken discussion into transcripts, action items and shared artifacts.
- [Google rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen for faster agent work](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-4-hydrogen-goes-global.html): Google’s new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model targets rapid coding and agent execution, combining lower cost, broad access and multi-model orchestration.
- [LangChain raises $300 million at a $3 billion valuation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/langchain-raises-300-million.html): LangChain has raised $300 million to expand LangSmith and sell a broader enterprise platform for building, evaluating and deploying AI agents.
- [Runway adds Seedance 2.5 Flash for faster video](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/runway-adds-seedance-flash.html): Runway has added ByteDance’s Seedance 2.5 Flash, giving creators a faster, lower-cost route into one of Asia’s strongest video models.
- [World Labs opens Atlas world-model apps and developer APIs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/world-labs-opens-atlas-apis.html): World Labs is opening Viewfinder and Chisel alongside Atlas APIs, letting developers reconstruct, edit and export explorable 3D worlds.
- [AlphaGenome 2 maps DNA effects across individual cell types](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/alphagenome-2-cellular-disease.html): DeepMind’s new model uses more than 100 million cell profiles to predict how genetic variants behave differently across tissues and cell states.
- [Anthropic files for IPO amid an unprecedented AI capital race](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-files-for-ipo.html): Anthropic has filed to go public, pairing a landmark listing with $26 billion in private commitments from major chip and cloud partners.
- [Fractile raises $720 million for memory-first AI chips](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/fractile-inference-chip-funding.html): UK startup Fractile reached a reported $7 billion valuation in a Series C aimed at commercializing chips built for faster, cheaper AI inference.
- [Google launches Gemini Decisions API for batch decisions](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-decisions-api.html): Google’s new Gemini Decision 1 model handles up to 1,000 multimodal choices in one pass, targeting fast, low-cost routing and policy checks.
- [Anthropic expands Claude into collaborative office work](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-claude-workplace-suite.html): Claude gains Whiteboards, Sheets and Data tools, while Claude Meetings begins beta rollout as Anthropic pushes beyond coding into shared planning, analysis and workplace execution.
- [Human-agent teams run auditable X-ray experiments](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/auditable-xray-agent-teams.html): A new arXiv study documents autonomous synchrotron experiments, measuring how humans and coding agents share decisions, errors and scientific work.
- [BotPsy tests compact agents for private local assistants](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/botpsy-local-agent.html): Tether AI Research released an open 0.8B tool-using model designed for on-device assistants, reporting strong benchmark gains but limited scope.
- [DeepMind upgrades Gemini Robotics and opens safety benchmark](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-robotics-25-safety-benchmark.html): Gemini Robotics 2.5 expands robot dexterity while DeepMind releases ASIMOV-Jailbreak to test unsafe instructions across varied physical scenes.
- [Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon for long-horizon agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-gemini-4-carbon-agent-model.html): Google’s new frontier model targets extended coding, scientific, cybersecurity and knowledge-work tasks with a 1-million-token context.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [ArtCraft扩大AI构建的开源软件套件版图](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/artcraft-rebuilds-open-source-tools.html): ArtCraft正用编码智能体以Rust重建熟悉的创意工具，把软件克隆从演示项目推向开源产品战略。
- [Anthropic推出 Claude Meetings，让智能体参与实时会议](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-meetings-builds-artifacts-live.html): Claude Meetings 首先接入 Google Meet，以可见参会者身份记录讨论、整理行动项，并在会议进行时生成文档和白板。
- [谷歌推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，主攻高速智能体执行](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-4-hydrogen-goes-global.html): 谷歌将 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 推向全球用户，主打更快的编程与智能体执行，并以较低价格覆盖开发者、企业和消费者。
- [LangChain融资3亿美元，估值升至30亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/langchain-raises-300-million.html): LangChain完成3亿美元融资，计划扩张 LangSmith 企业平台，用于构建、评估、监控和部署 AI 智能体。
- [Runway上线Seedance 2.5 Flash，视频生成提速降本](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/runway-adds-seedance-flash.html): Runway接入字节跳动Seedance 2.5 Flash，为全球创作者提供更快、更便宜的视频生成选择。
- [World Labs开放 Atlas 应用与开发者 API](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/world-labs-opens-atlas-apis.html): World Labs围绕 Atlas 世界模型开放 Viewfinder、Chisel 及开发者接口，支持从图片重建可探索场景并编辑三维世界。
- [AlphaGenome 2 深入单细胞层面解析基因变异影响](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/alphagenome-2-cellular-disease.html): DeepMind 新模型基于超1亿份细胞画像，预测基因变异在不同组织、细胞类型和状态下的差异化作用。
- [Anthropic启动IPO，芯片与云服务商拟注资260亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-files-for-ipo.html): Anthropic已向监管机构提交IPO注册文件，并披露芯片、云计算与存储伙伴拟通过同步私募认购260亿美元股份。
- [英国芯片初创 Fractile 融资7.2亿美元，押注推理专用架构](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/fractile-inference-chip-funding.html): 英国 AI 芯片公司 Fractile 以约70亿美元估值完成7.2亿美元 C 轮融资，目标是降低大模型推理的速度与能耗成本。
- [谷歌推出 Gemini Decisions API，单次处理千项多模态判断](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-decisions-api.html): Gemini Decision 1 可在一次请求中处理最多1000项多模态判断，瞄准模型路由、策略检查等高频基础环节。
- [Anthropic扩展Claude，进军协作办公工作流](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-claude-workplace-suite.html): Claude新增白板、表格和数据工具，Claude Meetings也开始向团队和企业用户进行测试版 rollout，Anthropic正把产品从编程助手扩展为协作办公平台。
- [人机团队完成可审计的同步辐射X射线实验](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/auditable-xray-agent-teams.html): 一项新研究记录人类与编码智能体如何协作开展自主X射线实验，并量化决策、错误与科学产出的分工。
- [BotPsy发布，0.8B参数模型瞄准本地智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/botpsy-local-agent.html): Tether AI Research开源0.8B参数工具调用模型BotPsy，主打端侧助手，测试成绩亮眼但应用边界仍然有限。
- [DeepMind升级 Gemini Robotics，并开放机器人安全基准](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-robotics-25-safety-benchmark.html): Gemini Robotics 2.5提升机器人操作能力，同时发布 ASIMOV-Jailbreak，测试模型在复杂场景下拒绝危险指令的能力。
- [谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Carbon，主攻长程智能体任务](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-gemini-4-carbon-agent-model.html): 谷歌推出面向长程编程、科研与网络安全任务的前沿模型，支持百万令牌上下文，并快速接入多款开发者工具。

## Pages

- [All briefings (English)](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/): the full feed
- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-11-13.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources
- Categories: [models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/models.html), [research](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/research.html), [policy](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/policy.html), [industry](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/industry.html), [funding](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/funding.html), [open-source](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/open-source.html), [safety](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/safety.html), [aigc](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/aigc.html), [agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/agents.html)

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
